sentences.en: Our future depends on the goodwill of a small elite.
sentences.zh: 我们未来的命运取决于一小部分人的善意。

sentences.en: Without goodwill on both sides, the treaty will quickly be broken.
sentences.zh: 如果没有双方的善意，这项条约很快就会被破坏。

sentences.en: The airline provided free accommodation to stranded passengers as a goodwill gesture.
sentences.zh: 航空公司为了表示善意，为滞留的乘客免费提供了住宿。
